name: shell_and_tube_sizing
title: Shell-and-tube mechanical sizing: tube counts, bundle diameters and TEMA rules (function library)
summary: Thirteen EES FUNCTIONs for the mechanical sizing of a shell-and-tube heat exchanger: TEMA tubing check (NPS/BWG), minimum bundle diameter, shell-bundle clearance, baffle and support-plate thickness, baffle hole diameter, maximum unsupported tube length, the rough tube counts of Perry's Handbook, VDI Heat Atlas and HEDH with their bundle-diameter inverses, and the two method dispatchers Ntubes and size_bundle_from_tubecount. Geometric estimates and TEMA table rules, no properties needed.

authors: D. W. Green and R. H. Perry (Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook, eq. 11-74)
TBD (VDI Heat Atlas, bundle-sizing chapter authors)
origin.notes: ht 1.2.0, commit 85e0ee6 (2025-12-07), file ht/hx.py, MIT license, Copyright (C) 2016 Caleb Bell. The tabulated rules are those of TEMA, Standards of the Tubular Exchanger Manufacturers Association, 9th edition, 2007 (organization standard, not a personal author), Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook 8E (2007), VDI Heat Atlas 2E (2010) and HEDH (1983), as cited per function. Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT license (decision D3).
